data.title: Ten-Frame Trackers: Reading the Blocks
data.description: Practice reading base-ten blocks place by place to understand the total value of tens and ones.

challenges.instruction: Look at the tens column. How many tens are there, and what is their total value?
challenges.hint: Count the long rods by tens: 10, 20, 30, 40.

challenges.instruction: What number is shown by these blocks?
challenges.hint: Each rod equals ten. Count the rods carefully.

challenges.instruction: Count the blocks above. What number do they make?
challenges.hint: Count by tens for each rod you see.

challenges.instruction: Check the tens place on the mat and state their total worth.
challenges.hint: There are eight rods. Count by tens up to eight times.

challenges.instruction: Read the blocks in the tens column for this final challenge.
challenges.hint: Count the five rods by tens.
